title: How a Sunken Treasure Became a Museum Star

segments.text: Ever wonder how a rusted lump turned into a star exhibit?
The wreck off Antikythera yielded statues, glass, coins and the mechanism, which arrived at Athens’ National Archaeological Museum.
On 17 May 1902 Valerios Stais and his cousin Spyridon spotted a gear wheel inside, sparking the first study.
The artifact broke into three main fragments, now divided into 82 pieces, with four fragments containing gears.
The largest gear measures about 13 cm in diameter and originally had 223 teeth.
That rusted lump truly became a museum star.
